name: valve_c17_secret_door
note: Kleiner's hidden lab door (d1_trainstation_05; d3_c17_01 has the same scanner without the door): a brick wall with a big sliding metal door and, beside it, a framed picture; pressing the picture tilts it, a wall panel slides and drops and an eye scanner swings out; a scan is refused (Valve's), or Valve's opening relay plays the scan to success and slides the door open
